crop.notes: 'The Arena' column of short sporting notes; only the third paragraph is about Allen (Joe Goss and Prof. Miller items around it)

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Allen and Charley Davis were matched to box in London with ordinary sized gloves under the Queensberry rules, for a £200 cup and the championship.

metadata.notes: No page image to check the masthead; dated before the 1878-12 Post-Dispatch merger, so filed as the Evening Dispatch

facts.fact: Allen and Charley Davis were matched to box with ordinary sized gloves under the Queensberry rules for a £200 cup and the championship, in London

notes: The paper itself queries the £200 cup with '(?)'.
